newsitem.title: CANADA: Breakwater Resources Caribou mine delay.
newsitem.headline: Breakwater Resources Caribou mine delay.

text.p: Breakwater Resources Ltd said on Tuesday work on its Caribou mine project is expected to resume in two or three days after water entered the underground mine on Monday.
The water entered the mine from old open pit workings at the top of the orebody, located near Bathurst, New Brunswick.
One employee was taken to hospital with a minor injury and was released later on Monday evening. The company said a detailed inspection of the site is being conducted.
"It is expected that normal activities will resume in two or three days," Breakwater said in a statement.
Work on the Caribou mine began in October 1996 and is scheduled to begin supplying ore by mid-1997.
